title: Injective module sheaves have vanishing Cech cohomology on a ringed site
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $I$ be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $\mathcal U=\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in J}$ be any covering in $\mathcal C$. For the underlying abelian sheaf $I_{\mathrm{ab}}$, the Cech complex [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] $\check{\mathcal C}^p(\mathcal U,I_{\mathrm{ab}})=\prod_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in J^{p+1}} I(U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_U U_{i_p})$ with its alternating restriction differential has $\check H^p(\mathcal U,I_{\mathrm{ab}})=0$ for every $p>0$.
